objective: Execute one OCLOB maker/taker match where each participant creates seven verifiable shares at its own edge, sends one encrypted share directly to each MPC node, and a commitment-only coordinator launches one malicious-secure MP-SPDZ party per node.
official_upstream_exception: MP-SPDZ compile.py is permitted only as the official compiler invoked through the Rust compiler adapter.

topology.transport: TLS 1.3 mutual authentication with pinned certificate SHA-256 and fixed-size records

privacy.participant_edge: The complete SecretOrder exists only inside its participant process before sharing.
privacy.mpc_node: Each node receives and persists only the ciphertext addressed to that node and opens only its own share.
privacy.coordinator: The coordinator receives commitments, edge admission receipts, ordering certificates and public matching outputs; it receives no complete order or set of seven shares.
forbidden: all seven shares in one node
private order fields in logs or artifact

required: both participant processes receive acknowledgements from all seven nodes
every node verifies the signed manifest, encrypted envelope and Pedersen VSS share
the coordinator fixes maker then taker sequence using 5-of-7 certificates
seven distinct node processes each launch exactly one malicious-shamir party
all seven signed receipts bind the same program artifact and public output
the maker rests 60 lots without a fill
the taker fills 40 lots at the maker price 100 and has zero remainder
replaying the same round returns the byte-identical persisted receipt without a second execution
reject_if: a node accepts another node's ciphertext or party index
the canonical MP-SPDZ source or compiled artifact differs between nodes
one node reports another public result
the coordinator receives or logs a private order field
a repeated round starts a second MPC execution

non_claims: Seven containers on one host are not evidence of seven independent operators or a WAN deployment.
This gate ends at distributed matching and does not prove live Avalanche settlement.
One scenario is functional acceptance evidence, not a throughput or economic comparison.
